statute: Section 170, CGST Act 2017, applied to a tax invoice's total
notes: From the CA's answer to CA-02 (CA answers document, reviewed by the CA; CA details to follow): rounding is applied only to the final total invoice value; the taxable value and each GST head keep their calculated values (gst-head-to-the-paise.provisional.json), and the round-off is posted at the invoice-total level. The positive cases follow Section 170's text. The negative cases are the symmetric rounding the CA's answer to CA-01 accepts. Replaces sec-170-cgst.provisional.json, which rounded each head per invoice. Nothing here is verified.
